      European regions

      From Europa Universalis 4 Wiki
      Jump to navigation Jump to search
      For a list of countries in Western Europe, see Europe western regions.
      For a list of countries in Central Europe, see Europe central regions.
      For a list of countries in Eastern Europe, see Europe eastern regions.

      European regions are regions that are part of Europe. The table content is out of the files in /Europa Universalis IV/history/provinces and refers to a game start on the 11th of November, 1444.

      Note: Continents, regions and areas of Europa Universalis 4 do not always match reality.

      Topic
      Continents
      African continent
      Asian continent
      East Indian sub-continent
      European continent
      Indian sub-continent
      Oceanian continent
      North American continent
      South American continent

      This article has been verified for the current version (1.37) of the game.
